articles.headline: No. 17 Minnesota women move to 8-0 with 69-50 win over Cincinnati in the Cancun Challenge
articles.description: — Natalie Kussow scored 22 points and grabbed 11 rebounds for No. 17 Minnesota, and the Golden Gophers pulled away in the third quarter to beat Cincinnati 69-50 on Friday night in the Cancun Challenge.

article.headline: Williams scores 18 to lead No. 9 LSU past Villanova 84-65 to remain unbeaten
article.description: — Mikaylah Williams scored 18 points and Grace Knox added 15 as No. 9 LSU overpowered Villanova 84-65 on Friday in the Fort Myers Tip-Off.
article.linkText: Williams scores 18 to lead No. 9 LSU past Villanova 84-65 to remain unbeaten
article.story: FORT MYERS, Fla. -- — Mikaylah Williams scored 18 points and Grace Knox added 15 as No. 9 LSU overpowered Villanova 84-65 on Friday in the Fort Myers Tip-Off. MiLaysia Fulwiley added 14 points for the Tigers (8-0) while Laila Reynolds and ZaKiyah Johnson added 10. LSU came in averaging more than 110 points a game and having a scoring margin of more than 69 points per game. While LSU’s tenacious defense led to nine steals and seven blocks, it also had a 44-22 margin in points in the paint and a 46-32 rebound advantage. Helped by four early 3-pointers — three by Kelsey Joens — Villanova (3-4) led 18-17 with 3:23 left in the first period. The lead didn’t last long. LSU responded with two 10-0 spurts. The first put the Tigers up 27-18 after the first period. The second spurt put LSU up 37-21 in the second period. The Tigers led 47-30 at halftime. The Tigers led by as much as 26 before Villanova ended the game on a 7-0 run. LSU made 33 of 61 shots (54.1%) while the Wildcats hit on just 24 of 74 shots (32.4%). Jasmine Bascoe scored 19 and Joens 14 for Villanova, which did make 10 3-pointers. EJ Bender added 11 points and Kennedy Henry 10. Fulwiley returned to the team Monday after being arrested Nov. 14. Multiple charges — including flight from an officer, resisting arrest, aggravated assault and aggravated battery — were dropped. She still will face three misdemeanors, but they could be dropped. She’s set to appear in court on March 22. Up next LSU: Plays N.C. State on Saturday in Fort Myers.
